about: nexus-day-order.yaml: reading it (a day and a list of ids per line; comments, other lines, bad ids and repeats left out; the last line for a day wins; CRLF fine), writing it (the header, days in order, a day older than two weeks or with no ids dropped), setting one day, and a time read for the order (minutes from midnight; before the day-start hour it is that night's).

write.about: old and empty days dropped, bad ids left out
write.expect:
# Your own order of each day's tasks with no time, as you dragged them in Today: the task ids, one line a day.
# Nexus writes this file on every device and drops a day older than two weeks.
2026-11-06: [a]
2026-11-20: [z, y]

write.about: nothing to keep: the header alone
write.expect:
# Your own order of each day's tasks with no time, as you dragged them in Today: the task ids, one line a day.
